detail.title: Revised: Computational Creativity and Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: Autonomous problem formulation frameworks are significantly enhanced by the capability for shared query understanding and structured evaluation in open multi-agent systems, moving beyond isolated agent decision-making.
detail.reason: Revising notebook findings to incorporate new evidence on human-agent co-discovery and active inference frameworks.
